cv_selection.constraint: within 2 percentage points of LightGBM (15 leaves, lambda 1, weights 1/1/1) CV accuracy

threshold_analysis.interpretation: thresholds are validation-tuned; their validation metrics are not an unbiased test estimate

error_analysis.note: gold forms are joined only after predictions, for post-hoc error analysis; they are never features

leakage_note: Grouped duplicate/fact-signature folds used. Shared subject-attribute histories can cross folds/partitions per splitting_audit.json.
outer_test_status: not loaded into any metric or model-selection computation
